description: Header file defining the cctz::time_zone class and related functions for handling time zones, conversions, and formatting within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: time_zone
classes.description: Represents a time zone with methods for lookup, transition, and formatting.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the time zone.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns civil and absolute time information for a given time_point.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Template method for lookup with different duration types.

methods.name: civil_lookup
methods.description: Represents the result of a civil time lookup, including handling ambiguous or skipped times.

methods.name: next_transition
methods.description: Finds the next offset transition after a given time_point.

methods.name: prev_transition
methods.description: Finds the previous offset transition before a given time_point.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the time zone data.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns a description of the time zone.
